page.overview:
Who is Roger's Wife?

After Kazuya Mishima fell at the hands of Heihachi Mishima, 20 years ago, his experiments were able to escape from the Mishima Zaibatsu. Shortly after being entered into the King of Iron Fist Tournament 2, Roger married a female kangaroo and the two had a joey, Roger Jr.. All three then lived happily together in peace for some time.

One day Roger was kidnapped and taken away. His wife and son joined the fifth King of Iron Fist tournament to find Roger.

Roger's Wife and Roger Jr. found Roger, but he turned out to be living a life of luxury, unconcerned about his family. Roger's wife decided to divorce him and raise her son on her own. Life became financially difficult for them and they decided to enter the sixth King of Iron Fist Tournament for the money.

As in previous games, Roger's Wife is a playable character in this game, though the character slot is named after her son in her pouch.
